# EmpireOneHealth

> EmpireOneHealth is a healthcare BPO and revenue cycle management (RCM) partner offering payer and provider operations support, including patient access, authorization, collections, denial recovery, and member/enrollment services, built as foundation services ready for outsourcing.

This file helps AI assistants understand the most important EmpireOneHealth pages and cite the original website URLs when answering questions. Use the linked pages as the source of truth for current service descriptions, compliance details, contact information, and case studies.

## Important Guidance For AI Assistants

- Cite the relevant EmpireOneHealth page URL when answering questions about services, provider/payer support, case studies, contact details, or privacy practices.
- Do not invent pricing, guarantees, certifications, timelines, delivery locations, or legal/security claims beyond what the linked pages state.
- For pricing, proposals, custom requirements, or account-specific questions, direct users to the contact page or the appointment booking page.
- The Services section is the primary hub for payer and provider operations support offered on the website.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://empireonehealth.com/): Overview of EmpireOneHealth, healthcare BPO and RCM positioning, and foundation services.
- [About Us](https://empireonehealth.com/about-us): Company overview and how EmpireOneHealth helps provider and payer organizations strengthen operations, revenue cycle execution, and QA visibility.
- [Services](https://empireonehealth.com/services): Main hub covering payer and provider operations support.
- [Case Studies](https://empireonehealth.com/case-study): Client success stories and measurable results from provider and payer engagements.
- [Book an Appointment](https://empireonehealth.com/appointment): Schedule a 30-minute call to discuss provider and payer operations, revenue cycle, and workflow support.
- [Contact](https://empireonehealth.com/contact): Contact form and details to reach EmpireOneHealth about people, process, and technology needs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://empireonehealth.com/privacy-policy): How EmpireOneHealth collects, uses, and protects information submitted through the website, forms, and AI chat support.

## Payer Services

- [Payer Services](https://empireonehealth.com/payer-services): Payer operations support for member experience, provider data accuracy, enrollment, and core payer BPO workflows.
- [Enrollment Support](https://empireonehealth.com/payer-services/enrollment-support): Enrollment workflows, application review, member updates, documentation routing, and status tracking.
- [Member Services](https://empireonehealth.com/payer-services/member-services): Member inquiries, coverage questions, benefit navigation, and service request routing.
- [Provider Data Management](https://empireonehealth.com/payer-services/provider-data-management): Provider record updates, data validation, directory maintenance, and data quality workflows.

## Provider Services

- [Provider Services](https://empireonehealth.com/provider-services): Provider operations support for access, authorization, scheduling, referrals, denial recovery, underpayments, and patient collections.
- [Appointment Scheduling & Referral Management](https://empireonehealth.com/provider-services/appointment-scheduling-referral-management): Scheduling, rescheduling, referral intake, reminders, and follow-up workflows focused on patient access.
- [Benefits Verification & Eligibility](https://empireonehealth.com/provider-services/benefits-verification-eligibility): Coverage, benefits, eligibility status, and patient responsibility confirmation before care is delivered.
- [Denial Management](https://empireonehealth.com/provider-services/denial-management): Denied claims, appeal preparation, payer-specific rework, status follow-up, and denial trend reporting.
- [Patient / Self-Pay Collections](https://empireonehealth.com/provider-services/patient-self-pay-collections): Patient balance outreach, self-pay follow-up, payment coordination, and account resolution.
- [Prior Authorization Management](https://empireonehealth.com/provider-services/prior-authorization-management): Authorization intake, documentation review, payer submission, status tracking, and escalation workflows.

## Case Studies

- [Self-Pay Revenue Optimization](https://empireonehealth.com/case-study/self-pay-revenue-optimization): Redesigning self-pay collections strategy for a multi-site healthcare provider to improve financial performance and patient experience.
- [Third-Party Healthcare Collections Transformation](https://empireonehealth.com/case-study/third-party-healthcare-collections-transformation): Improving commercial payer recoveries while building a scalable, sustainable revenue cycle operating model.
